name: 2. Single SOS Trace & Full ACK Cycle
description: Trigger Node 1 individually in a 10-node mesh and follow its exact forward broadcast path, duplicate suppression across neighboring relays, hub delivery, and return ACK route.
expected_behavior: Packet reaches Relay 100 or 101, forwards to Hub 0. Hub replies with targeted ACK. Origin accepts ACK and halts retries.
